title: In ork status, print the wave line after the multi-line wait's options

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Raised by the ui in round 1 of ork run ork-20261125-131038-69e9 for S499 (discovered from S499):

In ork status, print the wave line after the multi-line wait's options
status-engine lines 5-10 show the question on the row line, then `wave: wave-20261125-ab`, then the numbered options. The wave line splits the question from its options. The printer writes the wave at `internal/cli/daemoncmds.go:137`, before the remaining wait lines at `:139`. This was already so before this slice; the new fixture shows it.
Importance: 1
Urgency: 1
Effort: 1

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: `TestStatusShowsTheWaveOfARow` in `internal/cli/statusfmt_test.go` asserts the new order, with the `wave:` line after the last numbered option and after the `next:` line.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Owner decisions (2026-11-25): How should this slice's empty Files, Failing tests, Implement and Check sections say when it is done? -> tighten: Files `internal/cli/daemoncmds.go`, `internal/cli/statusfmt_test.go`, `docs/design.md` and `docs/dashboard.md`. Failing test `TestStatusShowsTheWaveOfARow` in `internal/cli/statusfmt_test.go` asserts the new order, with the `wave:` line after the last numbered option. Check: `go test ./internal/cli` exits 0, then `go test ./...`, `go vet ./...` and `gofmt -l .` are clean.. Where does the `wave:` line go relative to the `next:` line? -> after-next: print the question, the options, the `next:` line, then `wave:`. The `next:` command stays attached to its options, and the wave comes last. [ui.status-wave-line-order].

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: `go test ./internal/cli` exits 0, then `go test ./...`, `go vet ./...` and `gofmt -l .` are clean.
